name: overview_projection_20261114
comment: ANCHOR: OVERVIEW_PROJECTION_20261114 — the overview-projection lane, its builder, and the identity / path / invalidation plumbing the route depends on.

Successor to config/ci_gates/overview_projection_20261109.json, which retired together with its test file into archive/s2_overview_20261109_retired_20261114/ (R7 blocker, LEAD 2026-11-14T18:46Z). That gate pinned the pre-S2 reader contract — a route that reads the projection while fresh and computes INLINE on every miss, naming the reason in _projection — which ACC-CACHE r4 replaced by design: the reader is now LAST-KNOWN-GOOD-or-named-UNKNOWN and serve() never computes (S2 item 2, operator 2026-11-14).

The reader matrix half of the retired file is now registered under S2_READ_MODEL_20261114 (tests/test_s2_overview_never_inline_20261114.py). This gate keeps the half whose behaviour did not change (builder atomics/failure/overlap, parity, code identity, path override, invalidation registration, serve-never-computes, ETag byte-identity) plus five restated behaviours: the route binding, per-read dict isolation, the no-body cases for a missing file and a future stamp, the write-tracking-off sentinel, and a write older than the build.
archive/s2_overview_20261109_retired_20261114/COVERAGE-MAP.md maps all 26 retired tests to the test that carries each behaviour; nothing was deleted without a row and no assertion was weakened.
Synthetic documents and a scratch state directory only; no production DB, no Valkey, no scheduled job.
